nom: COSRX Clear Fit Master Patch - Day Care

avis.texte: These are my go to for reducing my blemishes! I use them over night or even just a few hours to help draw out pimples. I like how they can be used with exposure to sunlight and aren't super noticeable when applied, unlike some acne patches. Plus they're pretty affordable!

I've used Cosrx pimple patches in the red box and I love them, so I decided to give this one try. I feel like they are effective but I only went with these because it said you can wear them under makeup and I assumed that meant it would be not so noticeable. Except ￼they aren't thin enough for it to be under makeup because you would see the patch. That was the only down fall I would say.

I love COSRX pimple patches! I'd buy these constantly they are my ride or die. They have the red package and the black package the red package I love so much they're a little bit thicker they're great for overnight they suck up more of the pimple pus but I feel like you get too many small small sizes that go to waste unless you have like little tiny blackheads are pimples near your lab or in crease of nose. So although I do by the red package from time to time I've been more leaning towards the black package they're thinner you could wear them out and put make up over them are they noticeable well of course they are if somebody staring at your face long enough they're gonna see it but with the mask they're not LOl but these are ready for bed and they truly make a big difference your pimple is definitely decreased by the next day the more you wear them the more pus comes out. Sometimes you need to do it one night sometimes you need to do it two or three nights if I have a pimple that is Chyna extracted but still kind of feeling I will wear it to work just so I don't have any extra irritation from my mask as I do work in the health field and I'm wearing one all day long. I love these patches I hope they never go away they are one of my favorites besides the zip stickers with micro darts. You will not be Disappointed with this product at all! Another thing I like better about the black packaged ones are they are a bigger size so you get a little bit less but you get the bigger s

avis.titre: had high hopes.. they were crushed.
avis.texte: honestly they didn't do absolutely anything. no sugar coating here.

I've always struggled with constantly having two or three blemishes, even in my 30s, which I think is due to my pores too easily sucking in germs and dirt than anything else (yeah, gross). I don't have acne like you see on commercials, I won't pretend to know that struggle, but it still gets me down, especially since I end up impulsively picking and scarring, leading to needing makeup to feel confident. Nothing has worked (I've tried SO many things and have been vigilant) like these do. When I start to notice a spot, I pop one of these on so I can't touch it, and somehow the spot fades (I want to say it's like magic but that's real cliche). Not entirely and not so much I don't have to wear makeup, but it doesn't get worse and it definitely is smaller the next day. I also have pretty sensitive skin, so anything can burn me, but these don't. I wear them in private, as you can tell you're wearing them (even though they're "day" patches), but even if you use one from 10pm to the next morning it helps. This isn't medical advice, but I wear one every night (or as soon as possible when I notice a blemish forming) until the spot doesn't react to touch (meaning the swelling/infection has gone down so that it isn't that sore feeling like when it first crops up) and then it's pretty clear I'm out of the woods; if I catch it early enough I only have to use one.
I was worried these might be bad for your skin but so far they have been amazing!! Definitely buy them and use them on your white heads :) the only thing is that I wish it came with more!!!
These skin patches are so smooth and invisible! They don't necessarily go great underneath foundation and powder but WOW do they work for irritation!

these are great to wear under your mask and they're not very noticeable unless someone's up close, they don't work as well as the overnight patches but that's expected, they still do a good job at removing/treating acne
very thin and smooth so hard to see. they work great! overnight and a pore is deep cleaned!

i use the original and th clear fit. they both work, but the clear fit is pretty much invisible compared to the original. both work great to flatten a zit and help healing times and scarring, but there needs to actually be something to drain, so it won't work for say, cystic acne.

avis.titre: Totally invisible, works for surprise white heads
avis.texte: Occasionally I will get white heads that seem to pop up overnight and are very visible and close to the surface of the skin. Goes on totally invisible unless you're REALLY close to the mirror. DOES NOT WORK FOR DEEP ACNE OR ACNE WITHOUT WHITEHEAD. Will repurchase
I hardly get pimples or blemishes but these are so nice to have on hand in case one does decide to show up on my face. I like that there are different sizes of patches as well

avis.titre: I will never not have these on hand!!
avis.texte: I used to use a drying lotion but that was only ever good at night. These patches can be worn during the day time and help get rid of pimples easily and without damaging skin by trying to hard to remove them. My skin is loving them.

avis.titre: Amazing and super discreet when applies
avis.texte: Do what they claim on most blemishes. Can be applied under makeup or alone and are virtually undetectable either way!👍👍

I cannot day enough good things about these patches! They are definitely a spot treatment and helped me get rid of some acne spots before they turned into nightmare blemishes. One of mine was pretty bad and it took two days of wearing the patches; after the first day I was able to squeeze some of it out without damaging my skin and then put on a new patch. After that I was right as rain. No nasty zit and no damaged skin! It took a bit of patience but was well worth the effort!

I had previously tried the other pack of patches by COSRX in the red package and they did ok. I believe they come in different sizes, these however, do not. I had a very sore pimple on my shoulder so I used one of these and noticed it went down the next morning.. BUT the pimple felt harder and more sore than it was. I tried on some smaller pimples and you can see where something comes out, it helps if the pimple has a head, as others have stated.
These were okay. I could tell they pulled some stuff out but they didn't work very well for me. Maybe it's too far under the skin, I'm not sure!

These work if the pimple has a head OR in my experience when you pop a pimple it drains it out very well so you don't squeeze and damage your skin more. Adheres well and does pull out junk from the pimple but not if they are deep down under the skin. I will continue to use it and they are a good price

These seem to be an upgraded version of the other CosRX patches. I love them! They work extremely well; the longer you can keep it on at one time the better. They are also clear enough to wear out and about. Keep in mind that these are meant for whiteheads moreso than any "under the skin" type blemishes.
These patches work so well and practically erase pimples. They pull out impurities and are easily hide-able under makeup

These are better than the original in the red and white package. So far these are the best patches I've used and I've tried a lot. They come closest to disappearing, especially if used under makeup. They are very thin and flat, so they don't peel up easy, but they still seem to do the job just as well. A lot of other thin flat patches don't seem to absorb as much gunk but these absorb just as well.

I read the reviews and decided to purchase, and I will be purchasing more! I had two pimples, so I placed the patches on them overnight... WELL when I woke up and removed the patches both pimples were completely gone! And a great price by the way!

These little invisible patches are a game changer. I bought these to try, though I was very skeptical of their efficacy but I was pleasantly surprised. I get hormonal acne on my jawline, that tend to be deep cysts and only come to the surface after I have spent hours (sometimes days) trying to coax it to pop. I put one of these patches on during the day and no more than 2 hours later, I had not one but TWO white heads brought to the surface. I followed that patch with the other cosrx patch (red one) and my horrible zit was gone the next day. These have changed everything!

this product is pure gold. the day this product got to me I had a bit forming on my (I have hormonal breakouts there once a month, lovely) and it was so sore and felt huge and I could tell it was going to be one of those that lasts for days and looks ugly the whole time. so I tried one of these patches at night, woke up the next morning and it was at a head already, which was amazing to me it usually takes them days and its unpleasant the whole time. so I put another one on that morning, no makeup and you could not even see the patch they are basically invisible on the skin and this was square in the center of my chin. by the time I got home from work which was about 8 hours it had completely gotten rid of the zit and as gross as it is you could see the yellow stuff in the middle of the patch. disgusting but these patches are so worth the money and a must have on hand IMO. I will never be without these. Just wish I had had these in high school lol
I recommend trying the Master Patch. They hide blemishes quite well and help them to heal. Very delicate. They can roll, but if you get them on flat they are hardly noticeable. Good product.

The patches did not do much for my pimples. My pimples was ready to pop so I put on the patches and all it did was make it even more ripe rather than removing it. I tried the patches 3 times on the same pimple.

I had been using some other patches but they were too expensive so I tried these out! For the price they work great. You literally see the center filled up with the pus from your pimple when you wake up in the morning to take it off.

These heal up my acne so quickly! I can't believe the amount of junk is on the back after I take it off after 8-12 hours! They are nearly invisible on my fair skin without make up and pretty visible with makeup on. I will never use another brand!

I really like there's for the days I don't want to put makeup on healing acne spots. They cover well and sit nicely on the skin. Not totally invisible, they are a bit shiny. Makeup doesn't really cling to the patch and it's noticeable if you are looking. But it's worth it to know that my spots are protected and healing properly.
These are great for your cheeks although they are still slightly visible. It did manage to really control my breakouts
This actually really do work just wish there was more in a pack. I'll be stocking up

I really wanted to like these, right around that time of the month I get those big red pimples that need extra 'protection' from makeup and my prying fingers. however, although these are clear - they're SHINY. not matte. so to me, it was really obvious I had one on my face. I tried to cover w/ makeup but it made the outline/edges more obvious. they are thinner than the master patch and they do work.. just not meant to wear in public (in my opinion).

I love these patches. I have occasional cystic acne. When one finally came to a head I popped it (although you are not suppose to pop them) and I put on this patch. The next morning the patch healed it. Without the patch it would of looked "bruised" for days followed by a scar. These pads did a great job, it looks like I never squeezed it!

I really like these patches. They're great for day time! They're very thin and almost undetectable. They really reduce the size of pimples/blemishes, even big and angry ones. You can actually see the impurities (like pus) that the patch sucks out/drains when you take the patch off. Very effective. Even on cysts. They work best on lanced/popped blemishes, but still work on those that aren't - it just takes a little longer. I bought these with the other Cosrx patches and they both work equally as well. Only one size patches in this package though. I will rebuy these over and over again! Definitely need to stock up! I highly recommend these patches. Get them! You won't regret it!

This product works overnight to get rid of acne, for severe ance in 2-3 night it's completely gone. Although it says you can wear makeup on top it looks a bit off when you put foundation because its a shiny texture. 10/10

I use acne patches a lot and I've learned that some work better at different stages. So I like the master patch when my pimple is coming to a head and this patch the day after when it's open and I need something that will take care of the rest of the drainage. This one is more discreet and looks better during the daytime too;)
